issue.standard_remedy: Qualify a second source and shift volume
issue.summary: High-risk supplier (score 51) holds 20% of a category

plan.diagnosis: Apollo Chemicals Inc. represents a high-risk concentration with USD 1,305,390 spend (19.6% category share) and elevated risk profile (risk score 51, resiliency score 44, ESG score 47). Recent adverse media related to litigation and failure class 2 designation indicate operational and compliance vulnerabilities that create supply continuity exposure.

remedy_steps.step: Launch RFx to qualify minimum two alternative suppliers for Apollo Chemicals Inc. scope, targeting 10-12% category share redistribution (USD 130,000-157,000)
Conduct enhanced due diligence on Apollo Chemicals Inc. litigation exposure and failure class 2 root causes; request corrective action plan and financial statements
Award trial orders to two qualified alternate sources (USD 65,000 each) and validate quality, delivery, and compliance performance
Negotiate amended agreement with Apollo Chemicals Inc. including enhanced SLAs, quarterly business reviews, and risk-based payment terms (Net 60 to Net 45)
Execute volume migration to reduce Apollo Chemicals Inc. to ≤12% category share (USD 800,000 annual run-rate), implement monthly risk monitoring

plan.expected_impact: Reduce high-risk concentration exposure by USD 505,390, bringing Apollo Chemicals Inc. to 12% category share and mitigating single-source failure risk on 19.6% of chemicals spend.
kpis: Apollo Chemicals Inc. category share reduced from 19.6% to ≤12% within 6 months
Two qualified alternate suppliers activated with combined 8-10% category share
Apollo Chemicals Inc. risk score improvement to ≤45 or volume reduced to USD 800,000
Zero supply disruptions during transition period
Adverse media incidents monitored monthly with zero material escalations
risks: Apollo Chemicals Inc. may reject volume reduction, requiring expedited alternate source onboarding
New suppliers may require 8-12 week qualification cycles delaying risk mitigation
Litigation outcome could trigger Apollo Chemicals Inc. financial distress or Chapter 11 filing
Price increases from alternate sources may add 5-8% cost (USD 25,000-40,000 annually)
Quality variation during supplier transition could impact production schedules
erp_actions: SAP: Update LFA1/LFB1 for Apollo Chemicals Inc. - change payment terms from Net 60 to Net 45, add posting block flag for spend >USD 50,000 requiring approval
SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for two new qualified chemical suppliers with quota arrangement (Apollo 60%, Source A 20%, Source B 20%)
Coupa: Set supplier risk flag to 'High' for Apollo Chemicals Inc., enable mandatory risk acknowledgment on PR/PO creation, apply USD 50,000 PO approval threshold
Oracle EBS: Update supplier site to 'Hold' status pending due diligence completion (Weeks 2-4), modify payment terms to Net 45 in AP module
Dynamics 365/NetSuite: Add vendor risk classification 'High-Risk Concentration', enable budget check against USD 66,666 monthly ceiling (12% target ÷ 12 months)
All ERPs: Create purchase category spend alerts at USD 800,000 annual threshold to prevent exceeding 12% target share
